patterns.note: Alternating dark teal and white background sections are used to visually separate major content blocks and provide clear rhythm down the page.
A deep, rich teal/blue serves as the primary brand color for backgrounds and prominent elements, consistently paired with a vibrant, almost neon green as an accent for CTAs and interactive elements.
Content cards and entire sections animate into view with a subtle upward slide and fade effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
A 'Latest thinking' section features a dynamic grid of diverse content cards (events, podcasts, articles, case studies) with distinct labels and calls to action, showcasing thought leadership.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport with a solid background, maintaining its initial height and styling without shrinking or transforming on scroll.

Content blocks and individual cards are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements slide up and fade in from the bottom as they become visible in the user's viewport, likely orchestrated with CSS keyframe animations.
Text contrast is maintained by using white text on dark teal backgrounds and dark grey text on white or light grey backgrounds, ensuring readability across all sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) establish a clear hierarchy, complemented by a legible, moderately sized body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The distinctive use of a deep, rich teal/blue as the primary brand color, paired with a vibrant, almost neon green accent, creates a sophisticated yet modern and energetic feel. The site effectively uses a card-based content strategy to showcase a diverse range of thought leadership and services without feeling overwhelming, making it a strong example of a content-rich service site.
